latest_articles.title: A New Rival for PharmaEssentia? What Zealand Actually Sold for $100 Million
latest_articles.summary: Zealand Pharma sold rusfertide-related milestones and a 1% global net-sales royalty for up to $100 million, not control of the drug itself. The transaction clarifies how Zealand, Protagonist and Takeda hold very different economics—and what rusfertide could mean for PharmaEssentia's BESREMi.

latest_articles.title: 藥華藥迎新對手？1 億美元賣分潤
latest_articles.summary: Zealand Pharma 以總對價 1 億美元出售 rusfertide 的里程碑與 1% 全球淨銷售權利金，交易不是出售藥物控制權。本文拆解 Zealand、Protagonist 與武田的不同經濟位置，並分析 rusfertide 對藥華藥 BESREMi 的競爭、互補與治療分層。

latest_articles.title: DNA Is Not the Nvidia of AI Drug Discovery, At Least Not Yet
latest_articles.summary: Twist Bioscience is seeing rapid growth in AI-enabled drug-discovery orders and DSPS revenue, but demand growth, unit value and industry moat are not the same thing. The scarce asset may be the full wet-lab system that converts massive sequence volumes into proteins, functional data and model feedback.

latest_articles.title: DNA 不是 AI 製藥的輝達，至少現在還不是
latest_articles.summary: Twist Bioscience 的 AI 輔助藥物發現訂單與 DSPS 營收快速成長，但需求增加、單位價值與產業壁壘不是同一件事。真正稀缺的，可能不是單一 DNA 合成步驟，而是能把海量序列轉成蛋白質、功能數據並回饋模型的整座濕實驗工廠。

latest_articles.title: Merck’s Oral PCSK9 Drug Enters an Injectable Market: Who Really Loses?
latest_articles.summary: Lipfendra is the first FDA-approved oral PCSK9 inhibitor, lowering LDL-C by 56% and 59% in two Phase 3 trials. Oral dosing opens a major market, but cardiovascular outcomes, fasting adherence, payer access and Taiwan approval will decide whether it expands the category or displaces injections.

latest_articles.title: 默沙東口服藥殺進「降膽固醇針」市場，誰會被搶走？
latest_articles.summary: FDA 核准首款每日口服 PCSK9 抑制劑 Lipfendra，兩項第三期試驗在第 24 週降低 LDL-C 56% 與 59%。但口服不等於針劑退場：心血管硬終點、每日空腹依從性、保險准入與台灣核准，才會決定市場如何重切。

latest_articles.title: The Stronger the Backbone, the More Valuable the Missing Layer: Can Anbogen's ABT-301 Enter the Next Wave of Oncology BD?
latest_articles.summary: Big Pharma is paying for incremental efficacy around established therapies. ABT-301 has completed Phase 1; the CRC triplet's efficacy, sustainable dosing, durability and biomarker readouts will determine whether it can become a Combination Layer and open substantive partnering opportunities.

latest_articles.title: 主藥越強，旁邊缺的那一層越值錢：安邦ABT-301能否進入下一輪腫瘤BD名單？
latest_articles.summary: 大藥廠正為主藥旁的增量療效付費。安邦ABT-301已完成Phase I，接下來由CRC三聯的療效、劑量持續性、耐久性與biomarker決定其能否走向Combination Layer與大型藥廠合作。

latest_articles.title: Curium and Lantheus Agree to an Up-to-$8 Billion Merger: Radiopharma Becomes a Full-Stack Business
latest_articles.summary: The $7 billion Curium-Lantheus rumor covered in June became a definitive agreement on August 3: $102.50 in cash plus up to $12.00 per share in CVRs, for total consideration of up to $8 billion. The strategic prize is an integrated chain spanning isotopes, manufacturing, distribution, diagnostics, therapy and U.S. hospital access.

latest_articles.title: 核藥史上最大併購：Curium 與 Lantheus 合併，改寫的不只是交易金額
latest_articles.summary: 6 月官網追蹤的 Curium–Lantheus 70 億美元收購傳聞，已在 8 月 3 日推進為最終合併協議：每股 102.50 美元現金加最高 12 美元 CVR，總交易價值最高約 80 億美元。真正被整合的是核素、製造、配送、診斷、治療與美國院端網絡。

latest_articles.title: Who Could Be Big Pharma's Next Major Biotech Acquisition?
latest_articles.summary: Biopharma acquisition capital in 2026 is clustering around a narrow window: human risk has started to fall, but strategic value is not yet fully priced. Alkermes, Dyne, First Tracks, Legend and Sail illustrate five ways a biotech can enter that window, while Taiwan's Pharmosa Biopharm and Belite Bio show how late-stage assets can speak the same global language.

latest_articles.title: Biotech 下一筆重磅併購，會落在誰身上？
latest_articles.summary: 2026 年的生技併購資金，正集中到臨床風險開始下降、商業價值尚未完全定價的公司。從 Alkermes、Dyne、First Tracks、Legend 到 Sail，再回看國邑與仁新，真正值得追的是人體概念驗證、平台外延、商業化距離與買方策略契合度。

latest_articles.title: BeOne Bets on Four RAS Drugs: The Real Asset Is Development Optionality
latest_articles.summary: BeOne is taking regional rights to four RAS(ON) programs, opening two candidate combination routes and funding one global registrational Phase 3. The strategic asset is not the sum of four drugs, but the optionality to decide where capital and development speed matter most.

latest_articles.title: 百濟神州一口氣押上 4 款 RAS 新藥
latest_articles.summary: 百濟神州一次接進四款成熟度不同的 RAS(ON) 資產、兩條候選聯用路線與一項全球註冊三期。真正值得追的不是四藥相加，而是區域權利、開發分工與選擇權如何替雙方搶時間。

latest_articles.title: Moderna Surges 176.97% After Its Personalized Cancer Vaccine Clears a Phase 3 Test
latest_articles.summary: Positive topline results from INTerpath-001 sent Moderna shares up 176.97% in one session. The deeper valuation question is whether patient-specific design, manufacturing, release and clinical delivery can become a scalable platform.

latest_articles.title: 再見癌症？癌症疫苗來了！莫德納單日暴漲176.97%
latest_articles.summary: INTerpath-001 第三期頂線結果讓莫德納股價單日上漲 176.97%。真正被重新估價的，不只是一款黑色素瘤療法，而是個人化設計、製造、質控與臨床交付能否成為可擴張的平台。

latest_articles.title: NVIDIA Enters Pharma: BMS Readies 576 GPUs as Lilly Commits Up to $1 Billion
latest_articles.summary: BMS is preparing to deploy what NVIDIA's published specifications imply is a 576-GPU Rubin system, while Lilly and NVIDIA plan to commit up to $1 billion over five years. The real contest is whether proprietary data, wet-lab execution and clinical evidence can become one learning loop.

latest_articles.title: 輝達殺進製藥業！BMS 搶 576 顆 GPU，禮來砸 10 億美元
latest_articles.summary: BMS 準備部署依 NVIDIA 規格推算共 576 顆 Rubin GPU，禮來與 NVIDIA 五年共同投入上限 10 億美元；真正的競爭不只在算力，而在能否把專有資料、濕實驗與臨床證據接成研發閉環。

latest_articles.title: Just $74 Million Short: Can Skyrizi Succeed Humira as the Autoimmune Drug King?
latest_articles.summary: Skyrizi generated $5.505 billion in Q2 2026, only $74 million below Humira's historic quarterly peak. The real succession test spans efficacy, treatment burden, multi-indication reach and access.

latest_articles.title: 55 億美元只差一步：Skyrizi 要接棒 Humira 當自體免疫藥王？
latest_articles.summary: Skyrizi 2026 年第二季收入達 55.05 億美元，距 Humira 的歷史單季高點只差 7,400 萬美元；真正的接班考驗，是療效、治療負擔、多適應症與支付能力能否一起延續。

latest_articles.title: Eli Lilly Sold $23 Billion in One Quarter. Why Is It Still Rushing to Buy the Next Drug King?
latest_articles.summary: Tirzepatide has allowed Eli Lilly to dominate both diabetes and obesity, but revenue concentration, pricing pressure and the next product relay are the investment questions that matter now.

latest_articles.title: 一季狂賣 230 億美元，禮來卻急著買下一個藥王
latest_articles.summary: Tirzepatide 讓禮來同時吃下糖尿病與減重兩個大市場，但收入集中、價格壓力與下一代產品接班，才是市場真正該看的投資問題。

latest_articles.title: Revenue Jumped 39%, Yet Iovance Still Lost $47 Million: Can Cancer Cell Therapy Become a Business?
latest_articles.summary: Iovance's Amtagvi rebounded sharply in the second quarter, but the central question is no longer whether TIL therapy can work. It is whether a personalized cell therapy can become a reproducible, reimbursable and scalable medical service.

latest_articles.title: 營收跳增 39%，還是虧了 4,700 萬美元：癌症細胞療法翻身了？
latest_articles.summary: Iovance 的 Amtagvi 第二季營收明顯反彈，但真正要驗證的不是 TIL 是否有療效，而是個人化細胞療法能否被做成可複製、可支付、可放大的醫療服務。

latest_articles.title: Pfizer Paid Billions for Obesity Assets. Is It Already Cutting Its Losses?
latest_articles.summary: Pfizer, Roche and Amgen are pruning obesity programs that lack clear differentiation. The GLP-1 market has moved from a race to enter the clinic to a contest across efficacy, safety, convenience and commercial execution.

latest_articles.title: 百億美元搶來的減肥藥，輝瑞冤大頭又丟掉了？
latest_articles.summary: Pfizer、Roche 與 Amgen 同步清理缺乏差異化的肥胖症管線，顯示 GLP-1 下半場的門檻已從「有藥可做」升高為療效、安全、便利性與商業化能力的全面競爭。

latest_articles.title: GSK's US$2 Billion Cough-Drug Bet Hit a Phase 3 Reproducibility Wall
latest_articles.summary: After GSK's roughly US$2 billion acquisition of BELLUS Health, CALM-1 met its endpoint but CALM-2 did not reproduce the result. The divergence shows why Phase 2 promise, patient experience and reproducibility must move together.

latest_articles.title: GSK 砸 20 億美元買止咳新藥，三期卻翻車！
latest_articles.summary: GSK 約 20 億美元收購 BELLUS Health 後，camlipixant 的 CALM-1 達標、CALM-2 卻未能複製。這場第三期落差揭示：二期訊號、患者感受與可重現性必須一起過關。

latest_articles.title: This Taiwanese Biotech Is Building a Nanorocket Inside the Human Body
latest_articles.summary: Oligonucleotide therapeutics are moving from sequence design to extrahepatic delivery. Intelligene is using EV and LNP platforms to target the lung and airways, testing whether RNA medicines can truly reach disease sites beyond the liver.

latest_articles.title: 這家台灣Biotech正在打造人體內奈米火箭
latest_articles.summary: 小核酸藥物的競爭正從 RNA 序列設計走向肝外遞送；智新生技以 EV 與 LNP 平台切入肺部與呼吸道，挑戰小核酸下半場最值錢的問題：能否真正抵達病灶。

market_attention_signals.title: DNA Is Not the Nvidia of AI Drug Discovery, At Least Not Yet
market_attention_signals.summary: Twist Bioscience is seeing rapid growth in AI-enabled drug-discovery orders and DSPS revenue, but demand growth, unit value and industry moat are not the same thing. The scarce asset may be the full wet-lab system that converts massive sequence volumes into proteins, functional data and model feedback.

market_attention_signals.title: DNA 不是 AI 製藥的輝達，至少現在還不是
market_attention_signals.summary: Twist Bioscience 的 AI 輔助藥物發現訂單與 DSPS 營收快速成長，但需求增加、單位價值與產業壁壘不是同一件事。真正稀缺的，可能不是單一 DNA 合成步驟，而是能把海量序列轉成蛋白質、功能數據並回饋模型的整座濕實驗工廠。

market_attention_signals.title: Merck’s Oral PCSK9 Drug Enters an Injectable Market: Who Really Loses?
market_attention_signals.summary: Lipfendra is the first FDA-approved oral PCSK9 inhibitor, lowering LDL-C by 56% and 59% in two Phase 3 trials. Oral dosing opens a major market, but cardiovascular outcomes, fasting adherence, payer access and Taiwan approval will decide whether it expands the category or displaces injections.

market_attention_signals.title: 默沙東口服藥殺進「降膽固醇針」市場，誰會被搶走？
market_attention_signals.summary: FDA 核准首款每日口服 PCSK9 抑制劑 Lipfendra，兩項第三期試驗在第 24 週降低 LDL-C 56% 與 59%。但口服不等於針劑退場：心血管硬終點、每日空腹依從性、保險准入與台灣核准，才會決定市場如何重切。

market_attention_signals.title: The Stronger the Backbone, the More Valuable the Missing Layer: Can Anbogen's ABT-301 Enter the Next Wave of Oncology BD?
market_attention_signals.summary: Big Pharma is paying for incremental efficacy around established therapies. ABT-301 has completed Phase 1; the CRC triplet's efficacy, sustainable dosing, durability and biomarker readouts will determine whether it can become a Combination Layer and open substantive partnering opportunities.

market_attention_signals.title: 主藥越強，旁邊缺的那一層越值錢：安邦ABT-301能否進入下一輪腫瘤BD名單？
market_attention_signals.summary: 大藥廠正為主藥旁的增量療效付費。安邦ABT-301已完成Phase I，接下來由CRC三聯的療效、劑量持續性、耐久性與biomarker決定其能否走向Combination Layer與大型藥廠合作。

market_attention_signals.title: 核藥史上最大併購：Curium 與 Lantheus 合併，改寫的不只是交易金額
market_attention_signals.summary: 6 月官網追蹤的 Curium–Lantheus 70 億美元收購傳聞，已在 8 月 3 日推進為最終合併協議：每股 102.50 美元現金加最高 12 美元 CVR，總交易價值最高約 80 億美元。真正被整合的是核素、製造、配送、診斷、治療與美國院端網絡。

market_attention_signals.title: Who Could Be Big Pharma's Next Major Biotech Acquisition?
market_attention_signals.summary: Biopharma acquisition capital in 2026 is clustering around a narrow window: human risk has started to fall, but strategic value is not yet fully priced. Alkermes, Dyne, First Tracks, Legend and Sail illustrate five ways a biotech can enter that window, while Taiwan's Pharmosa Biopharm and Belite Bio show how late-stage assets can speak the same global language.

market_attention_signals.title: Biotech 下一筆重磅併購，會落在誰身上？
market_attention_signals.summary: 2026 年的生技併購資金，正集中到臨床風險開始下降、商業價值尚未完全定價的公司。從 Alkermes、Dyne、First Tracks、Legend 到 Sail，再回看國邑與仁新，真正值得追的是人體概念驗證、平台外延、商業化距離與買方策略契合度。

market_attention_signals.title: BeOne Bets on Four RAS Drugs: The Real Asset Is Development Optionality
market_attention_signals.summary: BeOne is taking regional rights to four RAS(ON) programs, opening two candidate combination routes and funding one global registrational Phase 3. The strategic asset is not the sum of four drugs, but the optionality to decide where capital and development speed matter most.

market_attention_signals.title: 百濟神州一口氣押上 4 款 RAS 新藥
market_attention_signals.summary: 百濟神州一次接進四款成熟度不同的 RAS(ON) 資產、兩條候選聯用路線與一項全球註冊三期。真正值得追的不是四藥相加，而是區域權利、開發分工與選擇權如何替雙方搶時間。

market_attention_signals.title: Moderna Surges 176.97% After Its Personalized Cancer Vaccine Clears a Phase 3 Test
market_attention_signals.summary: Positive topline results from INTerpath-001 sent Moderna shares up 176.97% in one session. The deeper valuation question is whether patient-specific design, manufacturing, release and clinical delivery can become a scalable platform.

market_attention_signals.title: NVIDIA Enters Pharma: BMS Readies 576 GPUs as Lilly Commits Up to $1 Billion
market_attention_signals.summary: BMS is preparing to deploy what NVIDIA's published specifications imply is a 576-GPU Rubin system, while Lilly and NVIDIA plan to commit up to $1 billion over five years. The real contest is whether proprietary data, wet-lab execution and clinical evidence can become one learning loop.

market_attention_signals.title: 輝達殺進製藥業！BMS 搶 576 顆 GPU，禮來砸 10 億美元
market_attention_signals.summary: BMS 準備部署依 NVIDIA 規格推算共 576 顆 Rubin GPU，禮來與 NVIDIA 五年共同投入上限 10 億美元；真正的競爭不只在算力，而在能否把專有資料、濕實驗與臨床證據接成研發閉環。

market_attention_signals.title: Eli Lilly Sold $23 Billion in One Quarter. Why Is It Still Rushing to Buy the Next Drug King?
market_attention_signals.summary: Tirzepatide has allowed Eli Lilly to dominate both diabetes and obesity, but revenue concentration, pricing pressure and the next product relay are the investment questions that matter now.

market_attention_signals.title: 一季狂賣 230 億美元，禮來卻急著買下一個藥王
market_attention_signals.summary: Tirzepatide 讓禮來同時吃下糖尿病與減重兩個大市場，但收入集中、價格壓力與下一代產品接班，才是市場真正該看的投資問題。

market_attention_signals.title: Pfizer Paid Billions for Obesity Assets. Is It Already Cutting Its Losses?
market_attention_signals.summary: Pfizer, Roche and Amgen are pruning obesity programs that lack clear differentiation. The GLP-1 market has moved from a race to enter the clinic to a contest across efficacy, safety, convenience and commercial execution.

market_attention_signals.title: 百億美元搶來的減肥藥，輝瑞冤大頭又丟掉了？
market_attention_signals.summary: Pfizer、Roche 與 Amgen 同步清理缺乏差異化的肥胖症管線，顯示 GLP-1 下半場的門檻已從「有藥可做」升高為療效、安全、便利性與商業化能力的全面競爭。

market_attention_signals.title: GSK's US$2 Billion Cough-Drug Bet Hit a Phase 3 Reproducibility Wall
market_attention_signals.summary: After GSK's roughly US$2 billion acquisition of BELLUS Health, CALM-1 met its endpoint but CALM-2 did not reproduce the result. The divergence shows why Phase 2 promise, patient experience and reproducibility must move together.

market_attention_signals.title: GSK 砸 20 億美元買止咳新藥，三期卻翻車！
market_attention_signals.summary: GSK 約 20 億美元收購 BELLUS Health 後，camlipixant 的 CALM-1 達標、CALM-2 卻未能複製。這場第三期落差揭示：二期訊號、患者感受與可重現性必須一起過關。

market_attention_signals.title: Novo Nordisk’s 6,300-Patient ZEUS Failure: A Textbook Lesson in Translational Risk
market_attention_signals.summary: ZEUS showed the central translational risk in cardiovascular drug development: ziltivekimab suppressed the IL-6 pathway, but the 6,300-patient outcomes trial did not reduce three-point MACE.

market_attention_signals.title: Can $1.2 Billion Help AI Double the Pace of Drug R&D?
market_attention_signals.summary: The Bio Genesis Mission is an attempt to connect supercomputing, biomedical data, AI agents, automated laboratories, clinical networks, and regulation into one R&D loop. Its real test is whether governed data and reproducible experiments can reach patients faster.

market_attention_signals.title: 美國砸 12 億美元，想用 AI 把新藥研發快一倍！
market_attention_signals.summary: 美國以 Bio Genesis Mission 串起超算、生醫資料、AI 代理、自動化實驗、臨床與監管能力；真正的成敗不在模型口號，而在資料治理、實驗重現與患者轉譯能否形成閉環。

market_attention_signals.title: 禮來領頭，大藥廠半年豪砸 1,300 億美元搶時間！
market_attention_signals.summary: 2026 年上半年生技製藥併購總額約 1,300 億美元，買家偏向臨床後期與接近上市的資產。這一輪不是全面牛市，而是大藥廠在專利懸崖前，用交易結構與現金購買可計算的開發時間。

market_attention_signals.title: $130 Billion in Six Months: Big Pharma Is Buying Time
market_attention_signals.summary: Biopharma M&A reached approximately $130 billion in the first half of 2026 as buyers favored late-stage and near-launch assets. This is not a broad biotech bull market; it is Big Pharma using cash and contingent deal structures to buy measurable development time before the patent cliff.

market_attention_signals.title: $2.2 Billion for the Next Autoimmune Blockbuster?
market_attention_signals.summary: argenx plans to pay $2.2 billion in cash for Forte and its early anti-CD122 antibody FB102. The real test is not one Phase 1b p-value, but whether VYVGART's product success reflects a development engine the company can repeat.

market_attention_signals.title: Investors, Take Note: Hair Loss Could Be Biotech's Next Weight-Loss-Drug-Sized Blockbuster
market_attention_signals.summary: Lilly has placed a $40 million bet on next-generation hair-loss drugs. With roughly 80 million U.S. patients still constrained by two legacy therapies, AH-001's Phase 2 data could become the next global asset-revaluation trigger.

market_attention_signals.title: More Than $1 Billion in One Quarter: Why Did Alnylam Plunge 28%?
market_attention_signals.summary: Amvuttra surpassed $1 billion in quarterly sales, yet Alnylam cut its TTR guidance and lost 28% in one day. The reset was not about RNAi technology failing; it was about pent-up demand normalizing, revenue concentration and the timing gap before a second commercial pillar arrives.

market_attention_signals.title: 超級大藥廠 4,000 億美元合併？阿斯特捷利康＋BMS！
market_attention_signals.summary: Financial Times 報導 AstraZeneca 與 BMS 曾探討結合，合計市值接近 4,000 億美元。這不是已簽交易；真正的產業問題是 2030 成長、Eliquis／Opdivo 獨占期、腫瘤管線重疊、反壟斷與整合能否買到時間。

market_attention_signals.title: Tau Earned a Retest: Why Biogen Is Taking Diranersen Into Phase 3 After CELIA Missed Its Primary Endpoint
market_attention_signals.summary: CELIA missed its prespecified dose-response primary endpoint, yet the lowest dose produced a 0.54-point CDR-SB difference, or 26% slowing, while CSF total tau and tau PET moved in the expected direction. That is enough to justify Phase 3 planning, but not enough to declare tau a validated second disease-modifying pathway.
